cohort: 14,642 deliveries in 2011 and 16,335 deliveries in 2014 at Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital, excluding incomplete data and miscarriages or termination of pregnancy before 28 weeks of gestation because of fetal malformations, intrauterine death, or other reasons
finding: Following a series of measures, the caesarean section rate at Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital declined from 60.69% in 2002 to 34.53% in 2014, with a corresponding decrease in perinatal mortality and neonatal asphyxia rates.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarean delivery on maternal request decreased in 2014 compared to 2011, while the percentage of women with a previous caesarean section increased.
